brief_details.what: Oxygen deficiency incident in confined space (wastewater treatment sludge storage tank). Maintenance technician entered tank without permit or atmosphere testing and collapsed at 3m depth due to low oxygen (11% O2) and H2S presence (45 ppm). Two additional workers (shift supervisor and operator) also collapsed during untrained rescue attempts. All three were rescued by fire department with SCBA equipment and transported to hospital with varying degrees of hypoxia injuries.
brief_details.where: DEF Wastewater Treatment Facility, Sludge Storage Tank #3 (5m diameter, 8m depth), DEF Environmental Technologies Inc.
brief_details.when: 18.03.2026 at 11:45 (incident timeline: 10:25 - initial entry, 10:28 - first collapse, 10:33-10:36 - failed rescue attempts, 10:55-11:05 - fire department rescue, 11:20 - hospital transport)
brief_details.who: Ahmet Çelik (29, Maintenance Technician, primary victim - critical condition with hypoxia and brain damage risk), Hasan Öztürk (42, Shift Supervisor, secondary victim - severe condition with hypoxia and head trauma), Kemal Aydın (35, Operator, tertiary victim - moderate condition with mild hypoxia)
brief_details.emergency_measures: 10:37 - Emergency services (112) and fire department called; 10:40 - Facility emergency notification; 10:55 - Fire department entered with SCBA; 11:00-11:05 - Three victims extracted from tank; 11:10 - CPR administered to all three victims; 11:20 - Ambulance transport to hospital for all victims
